'''Renneyn''' was a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] from [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]] in the [[Zolan system/Legends|Zolan system]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Renneyn discovered that he had developed [[Zithrom's syndrome|Zithrom's Disease]], which was a [[Kidney/Legends|kidney]] disorder that usually affected elderly [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|males]]. Unable to get any [[Clondex]], which postponed the disease, he eventually died in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], three years after his initial diagnosis.
